command:
$rd = "$env:USERPROFILE\flip-scanner-runner"
"=== FIXING RUNNER GIT ==="
Set-Location $env:USERPROFILE
$lock = Join-Path $rd ".git\index.lock"
if (Test-Path $lock) { Remove-Item $lock -Force; "removed index.lock" } else { "no lock file" }
git -C $rd fetch origin 2>&1 | Select-Object -First 3
git -C $rd reset --hard origin/main 2>&1 | Select-Object -First 3
"=== DONE ==="
Set-Location $rd
